content_zh:
如果不是身体里还有记忆，龙飞真的会迷路。
还是很快的找到龙大耀的院子。
“哐当！”
龙飞一脚就将院子门踹飞掉，站在大门口，喝出一声，“龙大耀，你给老子滚出来。”
“那里来的狗东西敢在龙总管的院子撒野？”
“来人，给我将这条恶狗打出去。”
“敢来这里撒野，找死！”
总管院子很大，一名小总管模样的人立即大声喊道。
紧接着。
五六名下人拿起长棍就冲了出来。
其中一人好像发现什么，说道：“他不是龙飞吗？”
小总管两眼一抬，冷笑一声，“龙飞大废物？哈哈哈……找了你半年，想不到你竟然自己送上门来，来人，给我往死里打。”
“无视少主，侮辱少主，罪，当死！”龙飞低沉的说了一句。
他们有些听不懂。
那名小总管鄙夷的冷笑道：“今天你是要死了，敢动大总管的亲外甥，你这废物早就应该死了。”
“给我上！”
龙飞一步踏出五级战师的境界释放出来，蛤蟆功的力量运转出来，右拳一动。
“砰！”
一人脑袋直接搬家，半截身体连连爆退，倒飞出十几米远。
倒地，鲜血狂涌出来。

“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’击杀‘恶奴’获得经验90点，真气10点，能量值10点。”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’获得50两银子。”
其他人面色一凛，目入凶光，全都扑了上来。
“砰！”
“砰！”
“砰！”
一拳一个，每一拳都是全力而动，全力而杀。
既然他们找了自己半年，那也就说明一点，乔乔是他们抓走了，想到这点，龙飞心中的怒火完全就压制不住。
拳拳爆杀！
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’击杀‘恶奴’获得经验90点，真气10点，能量值10点。”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’获得30两银子。”
“叮！”
每杀一人就会响起一道提示音。
面对该杀之人，龙飞绝对不会心慈手软，能一拳轰杀，绝对不用第二招。
几分钟下来，六名恶奴全部倒在地上，鲜血流了一地。
龙飞慢慢的走向那名恶奴总管，冷冷的说道：“低等下人竟然无视少主，侮辱少主，罪，当死！”
“噗通！”
“龙少饶命，龙少饶命啊。”小总管跪在地上求饶起来，道：“一切都是龙大总管指使的，一切都不管我的事啊。”

龙飞冷冷问道：“龙大耀在哪里？”
“龙家后山，关押犯人的地方。”小总管立刻说道：“他去审问乔乔了，他要知道你的下落，你快去吧，乔乔那小姑娘快要承受不住龙总管……龙大耀的酷刑了。”
“咯咯……”
龙飞双拳紧握，关节处咯咯爆响，目光充血，凝练出阴冷冷的杀气，转而一脚将那名恶奴管家踢飞出去。
“砰！”
就如足球抽射一样，曲线进入大厅内，一屁股坐在太师椅上，全身骨骼断裂，死的凄惨无比。
“叮！”
响起提示音。
龙飞迅速赶往龙家后山。
“疯了！”
“疯了，敢这样杀人，龙飞，今天你就是有十个脑袋也不够死。”
龙飞走后没多久，龙战武一群人赶来。
看着龙大耀院子内鲜血淋漓，场面惨不忍睹。
“他去哪里了？”
一名下人哆哆嗦嗦的回答道：“往后山方向去了。”
龙战武眼神微微一眯，沉声道：“通知龙家执法堂，叫龙战野带人去后山，今天我要好好教训他！”
“是！”
一名侍卫急急的退了出去。
龙傲满脸得意的笑容，“龙飞，准备受死吧。”
龙战武暗道，“龙飞，这一切都是你自找的。也别怪我这个当伯伯的残忍，你的龙神精血已经被抽离，如果你成为龙家家主必是龙家耻辱，你这废物也不配。我必须让龙家传承下去，你成为龙家家主的话只会把龙家带向毁灭，龙家也丢不起废物家主这个脸！”

龙家鸡飞狗跳，执法堂出动。
龙家禁军也出动。
后山一切都还不知道，安静无比。
龙家后山有一处山洞。
这是关押龙家触犯家规，或者惩罚一些下人的地方。
龙飞没有想到龙大耀竟然将乔乔关押在这里，进去之人就算不死也得脱层皮。
听恶奴总管的话，龙大耀还给乔乔动刑了。
这让龙飞更加的愤怒。
“龙飞，这里你不能进，你不能……”

content_en:
If it weren't for the memory still in his body, Long Fei would really be lost.
Still quickly found Long Dayao's yard.
"Clang!"
Long Fei kicked the courtyard door open with one kick, stood at the gate and shouted, "Long Dayao, get out of here."
"How dare those dogs from there run wild in Manager Long's yard?"
"Come here, beat this vicious dog out."
"If you dare to come here and act wild, you are seeking death!"
The steward's yard was very large, and a man who looked like a small steward immediately shouted loudly.
Immediately afterwards.
Five or six servants picked up long sticks and rushed out.
One of them seemed to have discovered something and said, "Isn't he Long Fei?"
The young manager raised his eyes and sneered, "Long Fei, what a waste? Hahaha... I've been looking for you for half a year, but I didn't expect you to show up at my door yourself. Come on, beat me to death."
"Ignoring the young master and insulting the young master are crimes worthy of death!" Long Fei said in a low voice.
They didn't understand.
The young steward sneered contemptuously: "You are going to die today. If you dare to touch the great steward's nephew, you should have been dead long ago."
"Fuck me!"
Long Fei stepped out of the realm of the fifth-level combat master and released it. The power of the Toad Kung Fu came out and he moved his right fist.
"Bang!"
One person's head was moved directly, and half of his body exploded backwards, flying more than ten meters away.
He fell to the ground, blood gushing out.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for killing 'Evil Slave' and gaining 90 experience points, 10 Qi points, and 10 energy points."
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for winning 50 taels of silver."
The others' expressions became stern, their eyes turned fierce, and they all rushed forward.
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
One punch at a time, each punch is moved with all one's strength, killing with all one's strength.
Since they had been looking for him for half a year, it meant that they had captured Qiao Qiao. Thinking of this, Long Fei couldn't suppress the anger in his heart.
Explosive killing with punches!
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for killing 'Evil Slave' and gaining 90 experience points, 10 Qi points, and 10 energy points."
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for winning 30 taels of silver."
"Ding!"
A beep will sound for each kill.
Facing the person who deserves to be killed, Long Fei will never be merciful. He can kill with one punch without using a second move.
Within a few minutes, all six evil slaves fell to the ground, blood flowing all over the floor.
Long Fei slowly walked towards the evil slave manager and said coldly: "A low-level servant actually ignored the young master and insulted the young master. The crime is worthy of death!"
"Plop!"
"Master Long, please spare your life, Master Long, please spare your life." The young manager knelt on the ground and begged for mercy, saying: "Everything was ordered by the senior manager Long, and everything is not my business."
Long Fei asked coldly: "Where is Long Dayao?"
"The back hill of the Long family is where prisoners are kept." The young manager immediately said, "He is going to interrogate Qiao Qiao. He wants to know your whereabouts. You should go quickly. That little girl Qiao Qiao can no longer bear the torture of Manager Long... Long Dayao."
"Giggle..."
Long Fei clenched his fists tightly, his joints crackling and popping, his eyes bloodshot, condensing a cold murderous aura, and he kicked the evil slave butler away.
"Bang!"
Just like a football volley, he curved into the hall and sat down on the Taishi chair. All the bones in his body were broken, and his death was extremely miserable.
"Ding!"
A beep sounds.
Long Fei quickly rushed to the mountain behind the Long family.
"Crazy!"
"You're crazy. You dare to kill people like this, Long Fei. Even if you have ten heads today, you won't be dead enough."
Not long after Long Fei left, Long Zhanwu and a group of people came over.
Seeing the blood dripping in Long Dayao's yard, the scene was too horrific to watch.
"Where did he go?"
A servant replied tremblingly: "He's heading towards the back mountain."
Long Zhanwu narrowed his eyes slightly and said in a deep voice: "Notify the Long Family Law Enforcement Hall and ask Long Zhanye to take people to the back mountain. I want to be well today."Teach him a lesson! "
"yes! "
One of the guards retreated hastily.
Long Ao had a proud smile on his face, "Long Fei, prepare to die. "
Long Zhanwu secretly said, "Long Fei, you brought all this on yourself. Don't blame me for being a cruel uncle. Your Dragon God essence and blood have been extracted. If you become the head of the Long family, it will be a shame to the Long family. You are not worthy of this waste. I must let the Long family pass on. If you become the head of the Long family, it will only bring the Long family to destruction. The Long family cannot afford to lose the face of the useless head! "
The Long family was in a panic, and the law enforcement hall was dispatched.
The Long Family Imperial Army also dispatched.
I don’t know anything about the back mountain yet, it’s extremely quiet.
There is a cave in the mountain behind Longjia.
This is the place where the Long family is imprisoned for violating family rules, or where some servants are punished.
Long Fei did not expect that Long Dayao would imprison Qiao Qiao here, and those who entered would have to shed their skin even if they did not die.
Listening to the words of the evil slave master, Long Dayao also tortured Qiao Qiao.
This made Long Fei even more angry.
"Long Fei, you can't enter here, you can't..."
